description: This file is a shell script that defines and runs performance tests for Git fetch operations involving bitmapped packfiles. It sources external library functions from 'perf-lib.sh' and contains functions for setting up test environments, creating repositories, and measuring performance and file sizes of packfiles with different age parameters.

methods.name: test_fetch_bitmaps
methods.description: Sets up and runs performance benchmarks for fetch operations with different ages of repository states specified in days, using the 'lookup' parameter.
